# Shadeflow

Shadeflow is a minimal black-and-white interface aimed at a high-contrast, distraction-free workspace. It bundles Inter for the UI, Geist for body text and Geist Mono for code so that typography stays consistent across devices.

![Shadeflow screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/artorias305/obsidian-shadeflow/HEAD/dark.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Shadeflow"
    author: "artorias305"
    repo:   "artorias305/obsidian-shadeflow"
    slug:   "shadeflow"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/shadeflow"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/artorias305/obsidian-shadeflow"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/artorias305/obsidian-shadeflow/HEAD/dark.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a minimal black-and-white interface for a clean, high-contrast, distraction-free workspace. Bundle Inter for UI, Geist for body text, and Geist Mono for code to ensure consistent typography across devices."
}
```
